Players Committee card image of [[Tycho Celchu (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. May reveal from hand to steal an unpiloted TIE from opponent's Lost Pile and deploy both simultaneously. Any snub fighter he pilots is maneuver +1 and immune to attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/tychocelchu.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
